title: Azure Databricks Genie Agents
summary: Azure Databricks Genie Agents MCP lets AI agents query a curated Genie agent using natural language to get answers from their data.
description: Azure Databricks Genie Agents MCP server lets AI agents query a specific Genie agent using natural language. Each Genie agent answers questions over its curated data, with Unity Catalog permissions enforced.

externalDocumentation.title: Azure Databricks Genie Agent MCP docs

useCases.name: Genie agent Q&A
useCases.description: Ask a Genie agent natural-language questions about its curated data. For example, ask for average monthly revenue; the Genie agent translates the question into SQL and returns the answer.
